load_scene_data: load and preprocess scene depth maps, intrinsics, and 3D points for a given scene name
compute_frustum_intersection: compute frustum intersection between camera views to find overlapping regions in a scene
project_points_to_views: project 3D points from one camera view into other overlapping views using extrinsics
sample_depths_at_reprojections: sample depth values at reprojected points using grid sampling to compare expected vs actual depth
review_covis_utils: review the co-visibility utility functions for scene data loading, frustum checks, and depth reprojection
